The Federal Reserve's October 2026 FOMC meeting is scheduled for Tuesday–Wednesday, October 27–28, 2026, with the rate decision and statement due on Wednesday, October 28. The official 2026 calendar lists no Summary of Economic Projections for this meeting — projections belong to the September and December sessions.
